validation.SIMPLE_REQUIRES_CATCH_ALL: Simple mode requires exactly one year-round catch-all fee rule.

validation.DATES_BOTH_OR_NEITHER: Each fee rule must set both season dates, or leave both empty.
validation.DATE_FROM_AFTER_TO: Season start must be on or before season end.
validation.MIN_NIGHTS_INVALID: Minimum nights must be an integer of at least 1.
validation.MAX_NIGHTS_INVALID: Maximum nights must be empty or greater than minimum nights.
validation.MIN_NIGHTS_BELOW_PROPERTY: Fee band minimum nights cannot be below the property minimum stay.
validation.MIN_NIGHTS_ABOVE_PROPERTY_MAX: Fee band minimum nights cannot exceed the property maximum stay.
validation.MAX_NIGHTS_ABOVE_PROPERTY_MAX: Fee band maximum nights cannot exceed the property maximum stay.
validation.CLEANING_FEE_INVALID: Cleaning fee must be a non-negative whole amount.
validation.PERCENT_DEPOSIT_INVALID: Percent deposit must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
validation.FIXED_DEPOSIT_INVALID: Fixed deposit must be a non-negative whole amount.
validation.FIXED_DEPOSIT_ABOVE_NIGHTLY: Fixed security deposit cannot exceed the nightly rate.
validation.BAND_OVERLAP: Stay-length fee bands cannot overlap within the same season.
validation.SIMPLE_FIELDS_IN_RULES_MODE: Cleaning fee and security deposit cannot be sent in Rules mode. Use stay fee rules instead.
validation.RULES_PAYLOAD_IN_SIMPLE_MODE: Stay fee rules cannot be sent in Simple mode. Use cleaning fee and security deposit instead.
validation.STAY_FEE_PAYLOAD_REQUIRED: A stay fee update must include fee fields or existing rules.
validation.EMPTY_STAY_FEE_RULES: Stay fee rules cannot be empty.
validation.MODE_SWITCH_SIMPLE_REQUIRES_CATCH_ALL: Switching to Simple mode requires a year-round default fee rule.

ai.a: On the AI Search page, type naturally — for example a cabin near Lake Sevan this weekend. We map your request to available listings, dates, and filters.

armenia.a: Right now we focus on short-term rentals in Armenia.
armenia.q: Do you list stays outside Armenia?

cancellation.a: Each host chooses Flexible, Moderate, Strict, or Non-refundable. The policy is shown on the listing before you book. See our Cancellation & Refund Policy for how fees are calculated.

currencies.a: Guests can view prices in AMD or USD. Hosts set listing prices in USD and receive payouts through Stripe.

list.a: Create a host profile, then use the listing wizard to add photos, amenities, pricing, and a cancellation policy. New listings are reviewed before they go live.

hero.subtitle: Short answers about booking, payments, cancellations, and hosting — based on how the platform actually works.
hero.title: {siteName} frequently asked questions

ai_search.a: Type a natural request, such as a cabin near Lake Sevan this weekend. We map that to available listings, dates, and filters.

contact_host.a: Open the booking and use in-app messaging. That is the fastest way to reach the host before and during the stay.
contact_host.q: How do I contact my host?

create_account.a: Sign up with email and a verification code, or continue with Google. You must be 18 or older, and your email must be verified before you book.
create_account.q: How do I create an account?

currencies.a: You can view prices in AMD or USD. Checkout charges the listing currency (USD); other currencies are display estimates only.
currencies.q: What currencies can I see prices in?

deposit.a: If the listing requires a deposit, we place a separate card hold, not a charge. After checkout it is released unless the host files a claim within {claimHours} hours.

deposit_claim.a: Hosts may submit a damage claim within {claimHours} hours after checkout. We review it; if approved, that amount is charged from the deposit hold and the rest is released.

host_cancels.a: If the host cancels on their own, you receive a full refund and the deposit hold is released.
host_cancels.q: What if the host cancels my booking?

how_book.a: Create an account, verify your email, choose dates, and complete checkout. You must be 18 or older.
how_book.q: How do I book a stay?

how_cancel.a: If the listing is not Non-refundable, cancel in your account before the listing deadline. Any fee is taken from the stay subtotal, never from the security deposit. See the <cancellation>Cancellation & Refund Policy</cancellation> for details.

how_list.a: Create a host profile from <host>Become a host</host>, then add a listing with the wizard or a spreadsheet import. New listings are reviewed before they go live.
how_list.q: How do I list my property?

how_search.a: Use <search>Search</search> to filter dates, guests, and location, or <ai>AI Search</ai> to describe the stay in your own words.
how_search.q: How do I find a stay?

is_safe.a: Card payments go through Stripe, deposits are holds, and stays use in-app messaging, reviews, and Yerevan-based support. {siteName} is a marketplace, not the host of your stay.

languages.a: The site is available in English, Armenian, and Russian. Switch language from the header at any time.
languages.q: What languages is the site available in?

non_refundable.a: You cannot cancel through the platform after payment. Contact the host or <contact>support</contact> if you need an exception.

outside_armenia.a: No. {siteName} currently lists short-term stays in Armenia only.
outside_armenia.q: Do you list stays outside Armenia?

payments.a: Card payments are processed by Stripe. Rent is authorized when you book and captured around check-in; we never store your card number.

payouts.a: Connect a Stripe account to receive payouts. After check-in we pay that account, minus the platform fee, after about {payoutHours} hours plus Stripe's settlement time.

platform_fee.a: The default host service fee is {feePercent}% of the booking value, deducted from the payout. Your rate is shown in the host dashboard.

report.a: Message the host from the booking first. If you still need help, use the <contact>contact form</contact> and include your booking details.
report.q: How do I report a problem with a stay?

reviews.a: After a completed stay, guests and hosts can leave reviews. Published reviews appear on the listing.

what_is.a: {siteName} is a short-term rental marketplace for stays in Armenia. Hosts list homes and guests book them; we provide the platform and payments, not the lodging itself.

who_operates.a: {siteName} is operated by {legalName}, registered in Armenia at {address}.
